line: Unboxing and close-ups of Aura, fictional glass earbuds, in strip-light sweeps and caustics.
line_cn: 虚构玻璃耳机 Aura 的开箱与特写。

camera.move: Sweep over a dark object, slow push

camera.expresses: The whole object in one move

camera.move: Macro, rack focus surface → part inside
Exploded view, axis ~40° to view, orbit
camera.serves: architecture; a pause before a turn

transitions: Cut only on beats (bar lines where possible).
Transitions are cuts on the beat or a sweep passing through black;
labels: Subtitles are a slab of frosted glass: a centred rounded bar filled with the live frame blurred (filter: blur() brightness() on the WebGL canvas, preserveDrawingBuffer: true), a little cool white, a thin highlight stroke and an accent line on top. A licence-free grotesk (e.g. Inter Tight), light weight, ~36–44 px, near-white. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).

Titles: the same grotesk at an ultra-thin weight (200), very large (100–140 px) with very wide tracking, centred in the upper third; a diagonal glint sweeps across the letters in sync with the sweep light on the object. Small tracked caps (18–20 px) for kickers and credits.
The product name and slogan are title cards, not subtitle lines.
motion: Everything moves on ones (24 fps), eased: ease-in-out for camera orbits, ease-out for parts decelerating into a float, ease-in for a snap back.
The camera always drifts: slow orbits or push-ins; never a locked-off frame, never handheld, except a couple of frames of micro-shake on an impact.

Exploded view: parts spread along the axis (~2× product size), each with a small deterministic tilt and a spin proportional to its offset; long ease-out apart → short drifting hover → very short ease-in snap on a downbeat.
Objects lift out of cradles tilted toward camera and settle upright; lids hinge at the back and stand behind the object as a backlit halo.

native_moves.name: Transparency
native_moves.does: The inside is the hero; rack focus from the shell to the part within.
native_moves.fits: a juicer's blades; a watch movement; a supplement capsule's layers.

native_moves.name: Lensing
native_moves.does: A thick glass dome magnifies and bends what is behind it; macro through it feels like looking into a jewel.
native_moves.fits: a camera module; a magnifying tool; a water filter.

native_moves.name: Dispersion
native_moves.does: A sweep crossing a thick edge becomes a moving spectrum.
native_moves.fits: a prism lamp; a display's colour range; a skincare bottle.

native_moves.name: Light that travels inside
native_moves.does: Energy (charge, data, heat, sound) runs as light through channels.
native_moves.fits: a battery filling; a router's data threads; a kettle heating.

native_moves.name: Caustics
native_moves.does: An internal pulse becomes a ring spreading over the floor.
native_moves.fits: a speaker's range; a perfume's trail; a wireless charger's field.

native_moves.name: Exploded view and snap
native_moves.does: Parts float apart and snap back on a downbeat.
native_moves.fits: a modular backpack; a pen's refill system; a repairable phone.

native_moves.name: Frost to clear
native_moves.does: A frosted shell clears (roughness and tint animate to zero) and the inside appears.
native_moves.fits: a privacy feature; a fridge's contents; an honest price breakdown.

score.note: minimal electronic, never piano-and-strings: glass bells, sub, soft kicks
